patterns: APPSC favours 'identify the incorrect/correct statement' on founder (Vijayalaya), successor (Aditya I) and titles (Gangaikonda = Rajendra I).
Strong AP tilt via Vengi: Chola-Eastern Chalukya marriages (Kundavai-Vimaladitya, Ammangadevi-Rajaraja Narendra) and Chalukya-Chola viceroys at Jananathapura (Draksharama).
Direct one-liners elsewhere: Brihadeeswara = Rajaraja I, Gangaikondacholapuram/Chola Gangam/Srivijaya = Rajendra I, 72 merchants to China = Kulottunga I.
Traps swap Rajaraja I and Rajendra I (north vs whole of Sri Lanka; naval army vs Srivijaya).
App MCQs match the PYQ shapes well; app adds more battle-detail (Kalidindi, Dharanikota) and 2026 current-affairs (Leiden plates).
